text:
maya: Heads-up — the inference svc 99th-percentile latency SLO started flapping during the nightly batch window and paged us twice last night. Anyone know where the metric/dashboard lives?

lucas: The Grafana dashboard is here: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inf-serving/latency?orgId=1&panelId=4 — metric name is service.inference.latency_99p (we feed it from the runtime exporter).

maya: thanks — can you paste the monitor query? trying to see if the noise is from the batch jobs or actual regressions.

lucas: Datadog monitor uses something like:```avg(last_5m):percentile(avg:service.inference.latency{env:prod,region:us-east},99) > 1200``` (threshold in ms). We also have a composite alert that looks at error rate spikes.

abigail: I saw the same paging. Paging during the nightly bulk jobs is expected — those jobs temporarily skew the tail. Propose two changes: 1) bump the 99p alert from 1200ms -> 1500ms, 2) add a scheduled mute for 00:30-02:00 UTC (nightly job window) and annotate the monitor with a tag `scheduled:nightly-batch`.

sre-oncall: +1 to the scheduled mute as a short-term fix. We should avoid permanent blind thresholds though — schedule should be recorded in runbook and in the monitor description. Also want a trace link to validate these are long-running batch requests and not many small requests.

maya: where do we look for traces? I tried Sentry but couldn't find the runtime traces for those requests.

lucas: Traces live in Tempo/Jaeger at https://tracing.redwood.internal/search — try filtering service:runtime and operation:inference.generate. For recent examples check traces tagged `job:nightly-batch`.

abigail: I'll open a quick MR in infra-alerts to: update the monitor threshold, add `scheduled_mute` block for 00:30-02:00 UTC, and include the Grafana + trace links in the monitor description. PR will include the Datadog query snippet and a note to revert the threshold change in 2 weeks if no regressions. Draft MR link when ready.

lucas: SGTM — I'll review. If we want, we can also add a short-term suppression rule in the alert router so paging doesn't show up for SREs except as a digest.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-145 created for last night's flapping (assigned to @sre-oncall).

sre-oncall: Thanks. If abigail posts the MR link here I'll review and approve during my daytime shift. Also please add a one-liner to the oncall runbook about checking `tracing.redwood.internal` and the Grafana panel before paging engineers.

maya: Awesome — appreciate the quick triage. abigail, ping when PR is up and I'll update the runbook with the trace/grafana links. :thumbsup:

abigail: will do, opening MR now -> https://git.redwood/infrastructure/alerts/-/merge_requests/384 (WIP).
